REPOSITORY.description: A source code repository or independently versioned project.

PACKAGE.description: A buildable or publishable package within a repository.

MODULE.description: A cohesive code unit that groups related files, classes, or functions.

FILE.description: A source, configuration, or resource file in a repository.

CLASS.description: A class, type, or other named object-oriented definition.

FUNCTION.description: A function, method, or callable entry point.

TEST.description: An automated test or test suite that checks software behavior.

API.description: A deployable application service that exposes an interface to callers.

WORKER.description: A background process that handles asynchronous or scheduled work.

DATASTORE.description: A database or other persistent data store used by the software.

QUEUE.description: A queue or stream used to exchange asynchronous messages.

EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY.description: A third-party library, service, API, or tool used by the repository.
